subject: science
concept: Understanding waves: wavelength, frequency, and amplitude, and how they relate to energy
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Waves) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student generates waves in a physical rope or spring and measures wavelength and observes amplitude changes
exercise.pictorial: Student labels wavelength, frequency, and amplitude on a pictured wave diagram
exercise.abstract: Student explains how changing a wave's frequency or amplitude affects its energy

misconception_flags: confuses wavelength (distance between peaks) with amplitude (height of the wave)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
